description: Feedboon — a visual bug reporting tool for websites. Users capture screenshots, annotate bugs and collect feedback. Next.js dashboard on Supabase auth. Organisations contain projects; each project has a feedback board with statuses, a team, and widget settings. There is also a QA Hub with a knowledge base and analytics.
notes: This is a local development instance — no Cloudflare or bot protection in front of it.
Signing in lands on / which lists the user's projects under an h1 'Projects'.
Project pages live at /projects/<slug>; settings at /projects/<slug>/settings/{general,board,team,widget}.
The login page also offers a 'Magic link' button — use 'Sign in' for password login.
It is a Next.js app, so pages render after hydration rather than at domcontentloaded.
